name: Paper View Board
description: An SVG board for your agent to draw on.
description_zh: 让智能体逐层绘制、检查和修改可编辑 SVG 图，也能生成图片。
description_en: Draw and revise editable SVG diagrams layer by layer, or generate images.
examples_zh: 逐层绘制一张细胞信号机制图
生成一张科研插图并打开画布
examples_en: Draw a cell signaling mechanism diagram layer by layer
Generate a research image and open its canvas
